description: UD-031 zero-initialisation variant of the oracle (oracle/patches/variants/ud031-anisotropic-damage-zero-init.patch + oracle/patches/variants/ud814-eig-noconvergence-zero-init.patch, UD-814): material point: anisotropic_damage_mazars/variant_ud031/2d_uniaxial (uniaxial load/unload path, 20 steps)

build.cxx_flags: -ffp-contract=off -DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -g3 -ggdb3 -flarge-source-files -std=c++20 -flto=auto -fno-fat-lto-objects -fPIC -frounding-math (actual flags of src/model/solid_mechanics/solid_mechanics_model.cc; warnings and non-FP -D defines omitted)

quantities.name: input/grad_u_prescribed
quantities.description: input: prescribed H_k (u = H_k X) for every requested step

quantities.name: grad_u
quantities.description: displacement gradient stored by the material after the step (computeAllStresses: FE gradient of u = H X; plastic_mazars stores (grad_u - eps_p) + eps_p)

quantities.name: stress
quantities.description: Cauchy/first-PK stress as stored by the material (getStress)

quantities.name: tangent
quantities.description: computeTangentModuli: d sigma_row / d epsilon_col in Akantu Voigt order (parameters.voigt_order; 1D xx, 2D xx yy xy, 3D xx yy zz yz xz xy; shear components act on engineering strains 2 eps_ij); stored [row, col] row-major

quantities.name: internal/elastic_stress
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

quantities.name: internal/equivalent_strain
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

quantities.name: internal/trace_damage
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

quantities.name: internal/damage
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

notes: Oracle VARIANT golden (D-003 A): regenerated on the strict x86_64 oracle (the unpinned install, image sha256:45122c21...; Eigen's cache sizes pinned at run time in the probe, D-050) rebuilt with oracle/patches/variants/ud031-anisotropic-damage-zero-init.patch (zero-initialised A_diag in tensorPlusOp, UD-031) and oracle/patches/variants/ud814-eig-noconvergence-zero-init.patch (zero eigenpairs after a non-converging EigenSolver in MatrixBase::eig, UD-814); reference.patches lists both patched files, parameters.oracle_variant labels them (UD-814 under additional_patches). This is the defined behaviour the akantu-rs port reproduces in LawOptions::anisotropic_damage = Upstream. 3 identical runs in 3 container starts; valgrind memcheck finds no uninitialised read on that build; every data and input file is byte-identical to the earlier golden from the UD-031-only build (which an independent review also regenerated byte-identical on a compile-time pinned rebuild). Not a golden of the unpatched oracle. Default quiet NaNs (D-046 (4)): they are legitimate output of the reference code (UD-031/UD-058, not a usable law). Tangent: each time a point reaches the broken state (tr D' > Dc in tension) material_anisotropic_damage_tmpl.hh:229-238 rewrites the material-wide E and nu so that kappa <- (1 - Dc) kappa at fixed lambda; repeated, 3 kappa - lambda goes through 0 (lambda = -inf, mu = +inf at step index 8, lambda + 2 mu = NaN). Damage, stress and energy/potential: from step index 16 the unloading path makes every principal strain non-positive, so epsilon_hat = 0 while the threshold test passes (K(TrD = 0) = -K0 < 0) and delta_lambda = (TrD' - TrD)/epsilon_hat^2 is a division by zero; its product with the zero epsilon_plus is NaN, which propagates to D and to the stress and energy. Signs: x86_64 SSE gives 0xfff8000000000000 except where noted; equal to the aarch64 0x7ff8000000000000 under D-046 (1). NaN positions: tangent 57 values (Voigt entries 0 and 4 at step index 8; entries 0, 1, 3, 4, 8 from step index 9); stress 16, internal/damage 16, energy/potential 4 (every entry from step index 16). NaN quantities (count of 93 values): stress (16), tangent (57), energy/potential (4), internal/damage (16); all default quiet NaNs (D-046 (4); structured inventory: review V100 MX3-02).
